summary: New in Update 17.0. Raiding infantry civ whose Town Centers make villagers for free up to a cap that Longhouses raise. Most players open Konungr Hall into a 2nd TC; the aggressive line is Baugr Fort with Hardened Berserkers and Bondi.
openings: Konungr Hall 2 TC (Swaggy, Valdy): 3 on gold, everyone to wood at 200 gold, Hall at about 2:00, Feudal around 4:15, 2nd TC by 5:00, then Longhouses with Bee Skeps.
Baugr Fort aggression: Feudal around 4:00 with Hardened Berserkers and Bondi raiding gold and wood lines.
Castle around 10:30 with Valdemar Castle for Jylland Knights, or Gullinn Temple for Sacred Groves.

spikes.label: Early Berserkers and Bondi
spikes.detail: Berserkers and Bondi exist from the Dark Age and heal by eating from any food source, including your berries and deer.
spikes.answer: Archers behind a palisade, or a tower on your gold. Pull villagers into the TC rather than trading.

spikes.label: Free villagers and Shield Maidens
spikes.detail: Two TCs pump villagers with no food cost, and Konungr Hall adds Shield Maidens that protect villagers.
spikes.answer: Hit the Longhouses: every one you kill lowers their villager cap and population.

spikes.label: Jylland Knights and Sacred Groves
spikes.detail: Valdemar Castle brings cheaper Jylland Knights and Danevirke walls; Gullinn Temple lets Völur turn relics into Sacred Groves that spawn free Berserkers.
spikes.answer: Spearmen and crossbows against the knights. Contest relics early or burn the Groves.

spikes.label: 220 population
spikes.detail: Population goes to 210, or 220 with Folkekirken, and Leikr Training buffs melee infantry.
spikes.answer: Don't trade late into a maxed Viking army; win earlier or out-range them with handcannons and siege.

scout: Konungr Hall plus stone villagers means a 2nd TC boom
Baugr Fort means Berserker and Bondi aggression soon
Number of Longhouses: their villager cap and how hard they're booming
Völur heading to relics means Sacred Groves

pairings.why: Fast damage plus anti-cavalry spears that grow tougher in a group (shield wall).
Armored front line in front of cheap ranged damage.
Cheaper knights that refund gold when they die, backed by heavy infantry.

winConditions.detail: Melee infantry pressure that heals off the map's food.
Free villager production from two TCs plus Longhouse upgrades.
Sacred Groves on relics make free Berserkers.

howToBeat: Kill Longhouses: they hold the villager cap, population and free upgrades.
Archers and towers handle the early Berserker and Bondi pressure; they have no ranged answer until Feudal archers.
Spearmen and crossbows against Jylland Knights in Castle.
They have no stone walls. Danevirke palisades resist torches, but rams and siege still break them.
